subject: art-design
title: Line, Shape & Form Deep Dive
welcome_lead: Master the first three formal elements in detail.
meta_desc: KS3 formal elements: types of line, shape geometry, form making.
final_note: Line, shape and form — the bones of every drawing.

concepts.def: Line showing the edge of a shape.
Regular shape like a square or circle.

walkthroughs.body_html: Lines can be thick, thin, jagged, curving, dotted or implied. A contour line describes edges; an implied line is suggested by direction without being drawn.
Geometric shapes have rules and angles — squares, triangles, hexagons. Organic shapes are flowing and natural — leaves, clouds, puddles.
Forms include cubes, spheres, cylinders, cones and pyramids. Sculptors carve, cast or build them. Drawers use tone to give the illusion of form on flat paper.
